description: Converted pickup truck with a covered rear bed and two facing bench seats, run as a fixed-route shared taxi.

image.prompt:
Product photograph of one isolated object, shot from a HIGH THREE-QUARTER ANGLE: the camera is well above the object and tilted down about 30 degrees, so the top of the object is clearly visible along with its front and one side. Not a straight-on elevation.

The object: Converted pickup truck shared taxi, open rear bed with two long facing bench seats and a steel canopy frame over corrugated roof, open sides with grab rails, rear step and roof rack Materials: Faded single-colour enamel paint, chalky sun-bleached roof, scuffed steel bed floor, worn vinyl bench pads, dusty wheel arches.

Form: build the object from a few simple, chunky, closed volumes. Prefer solid panels over lattice, mesh, grilles or perforated screens; keep any openings few, large and clearly separated. No thin spindly protrusions, no wires, no chains, no fringes, no lace, no fine filigree, no dense repeated slots or cut-outs. Keep the silhouette simple and readable from every side. Keep the object's SHAPE simple; richness must come from the surface finish, wear and materials rather than from intricate geometry. The object is still photoreal and highly detailed in its texture -- only its form is simple.

Framing: long-lens near-orthographic perspective, minimal foreshortening. The object is perfectly centred and occupies about 75% of the frame height, with clear empty margin on all four sides. The whole object is in frame; nothing is cropped.

Background: completely flat seamless neutral 50% grey (#808080). The object floats in empty space against an infinite seamless backdrop, photographed as a cut-out with nothing underneath it. There is no surface for it to rest on and nothing for it to cast a shadow onto. No floor, no ground plane, no horizon line, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no vignette, no gradient.

Lighting: flat even studio illumination from all sides, soft and shadowless, like a lightbox. No strong key light, no rim light, no coloured light, no specular blowout, no dramatic highlights. Colours must read as true albedo.

One object only, nothing else in frame. No people, no hands, no other props, no packaging, no text, no labels, no watermarks, no measurement annotations, no arrows, no borders, no drop shadow.

Photoreal, sharp focus edge to edge, clean and undamaged geometry, realistic materials and surface wear. Not stylised, not cartoon, not low-poly, not a 3D render preview, not a wireframe.

license.notice: Fully synthetic. No third-party scanned or scraped geometry.

review.critique: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.91. 6,262/8,000 triangles, 5/6 draw calls, 4/4 materials, 5/8 unique geometries, three canvases at 2.0 MB, factory ~70 ms. Turntable: enclosed background is the open cage, allowed on measurement. Colliders re-derived: 8 boxes, coverage 0.958.

The sheet overhangs the cab back as the plate shows. The plate is a rear three-quarter and the cage, benches, roof and step are all read directly off it.
featureReviews.notes: Built as tinted boxes on one white material, each standing proud of the shell.

featureReviews.evidence: Four instanced wheels off one lathe with the rim a step apart from the tyre; pivots wheel-front-l/r and wheel-rear-l/r on the axle at each hub, exposed on sculptRuntime.
featureReviews.notes: Dusty pressed-steel wheels in the plate (region-tyre 0.86): dished rim #9a8a72 with a #5a4e40 vent ring and hub cap against tyre #847666 with an alternating tread; replaces the closed grey domes of the second build.

featureReviews.evidence: Yellow authored #d8a850 against the plate door #e0b352 (the second build rendered beige at sat 0.31); dust #b2925f carried on a per-channel-max envelope #d8a85f with both as linear ratios on a zoned 512 px mud tile; glass a sky-gradient tile on #7a786e; frame #4e3a28 and benches #4e3c30 to the plate; corrugation as a 256 px sine-ridge canvas on the sheet at 0.60 troughs, bump 0.02.
featureReviews.notes: The roof ridges read at prop distance in the hero render with rust marks; the dust reads as a mottled tan film up the bed sides and doors as the plate shows. Residual: the plate frame carries streaked rust the flat tubes do not.

featureReviews.evidence: Six dark-rust tube uprights (#4e3a28 to the plate #362a1d) with three rails a side, two cross bars and a rack rim seated on a corrugated sheet at 2.155-2.185 m, its ridges at 0.60 troughs and 0.02 bump; two dark timber benches with backs above the rails over a rusted floor; open rear with a step.
featureReviews.notes: The turntable gate flags the backdrop seen through the cage at all four azimuths (212 x 63 px above the cab under the overhang at 0; 204 x 29 and 237 x 103 between the rails at 90 and 270; a 24 x 118 slit out the open rear at 180). All of it is real open air -- the passengers look out through exactly those gaps -- so --allow-holes is set on the _holecc measurement, the mosque-courtyard case and not an unexplained failure.

name: Songthaew
notes: Length is real: a Hilux-based songthaew runs about 5.4 m, which lands it in the hero budget class rather than the vehicle category's 4.5 m prior. Body is one asset including the canopy and benches -- the canopy is welded on in reality and does not detach. Declared with no destruction groups: it is a background traffic and parking prop, not a breakable.
